method: OpenStreetMap building footprint way 100705587, name '北カウンターホール' (North Counter Hall), used verbatim.
name: KEK North Counter Hall
notes: Uncertain identification: no source consulted gives this building's exact role. It is associated with the KEK 12 GeV proton synchrotron (KEK-PS) because (1) its OpenStreetMap name uses accelerator-hall terminology ('counter hall', a beamline experimental hall, not a generic building), (2) the K2K tutorial and FAQ pages describe the K2K beam (driven by the KEK-PS) as bent 'from the North hall towards Kamioka', and (3) it sits on the KEK campus between the KEK injector linac and the Tsukuba/Photon-Factory halls, consistent with the historical 12 GeV PS site. No source consulted gives the PS ring's own tunnel path (two targeted Overpass searches for tunnel, man_made=particle_accelerator or landuse ways near this building found none); only this one building is drawn for the KEK-PS, not the ring.
Because the identification of this building with the 12 GeV PS is circumstantial (name match only), the feature is kept as context and the KEK-PS accelerator is listed as not located on this map.

summary.plain: A KEK building associated by name and by a K2K-era source with the 'North hall' from which the KEK-PS neutrino beam left for Kamioka; the ring itself is not drawn (no sourced trace).
